seo.title: Meal Diary — shared weekly meal planner for households
seo.description: Plan the week together, keep recipes in one place (including import from URL), and shop from an aisle-sorted list. Free for small households; Family Plus when you need more.

hero.title: The shared meal diary your household actually uses
hero.subtitle: Plan breakfast, lunch and dinner for the week, cook from your recipe book, and tick off shopping by aisle — all in one place.

story.title: Plan → recipes → shop
story.body: Meal Diary is built for households who share one kitchen. Put the week on the diary, keep favourite recipes ready (or import them from a website), then generate a shopping list you can sort by aisle.

diary.title: See the week at a glance
diary.body: Navigate weeks, expand a day, and set breakfast, lunch and dinner together. Everyone in the family group sees the same plan.
diary.alt: Meal Diary mobile screenshot showing a weekly meal plan with Saturday expanded

recipes.title: A recipe book that grows with you
recipes.body: Save family favourites with portions and ingredients, or import a recipe from a URL when you find something you want to cook.
recipes.alt: Meal Diary recipe book screenshot listing saved recipes

import.title: Create by hand or import from a link
import.body: Start with an empty recipe form, or paste a recipe website URL and pull in what we can — then tidy it up for your household.
import.alt: Meal Diary new recipe dialog offering create manually or import from URL

shopping.title: Shop by aisle, not by chaos
shopping.body: Your shared shopping list groups items by category — meat, fruit & veg, dairy and more — so the supermarket trip stays calm.
shopping.alt: Meal Diary shopping list screenshot with aisle category filters

sharing.title: Built for family groups
sharing.body: Create or join a household, share one diary and one shopping list, and stop chasing messages about what’s for dinner.

trust.title: Privacy-minded by design
trust.body: Optional analytics (Google Analytics and PostHog) only run after you accept them. Essential cookies keep the site working and remember your cookie choice — nothing analytics-related loads until you allow it.

finalCta.title: Ready to plan this week?
finalCta.body: Open the web app to create your household diary. Native apps are coming soon.

seo.title: About & FAQ — Meal Diary
seo.description: Meal Diary is a UK household meal planner: shared weekly diary, recipes with URL import, and an aisle-sorted shopping list.

about.title: About Meal Diary
about.subtitle: A calm planner for UK households who cook together.
about.body: Meal Diary helps families plan the week’s meals, keep recipes in one book, and shop from a shared list. We’re not a calorie tracker, delivery service, or AI meal robot — just a practical diary for the kitchen you already have.

what.a: Meal Diary is a shared weekly meal planner with a recipe book (including import from URL) and an aisle-sorted shopping list for your household.

who.a: UK households and family groups who want one place to plan meals, save recipes, and shop together.

stores.q: Is there an iOS or Android app?
stores.a: Native apps are coming soon. Today you can use the full web app in your browser.

pricing.a: There’s a Free plan and Family Plus with higher limits. See the pricing page for a summary, then open the web app for current prices and checkout.

cookies.a: Essential cookies keep the site working and remember your cookie choice. Optional Analytics cookies (Google Analytics and PostHog, including usage and error reporting) only load after you accept them. You can reopen Cookie preferences any time from the footer.

privacy.q: Where can I read the privacy policy?
privacy.a: Open the privacy policy from the footer — it explains how we handle data for Meal Diary.
